title: Construction Products Regulation (EU) 2024/3110

productGroups.notes: retentionYears is sourced: the Regulation imposes 10 years on the economic operator. In force since 2025-01-07 and applicable in stages from 2026-01-08, but the per-product duty depends on harmonised technical specifications plus delegated and implementing acts, so nothing is determinable. The 18 months is Art. 22(7), counted from the delegated act that sets up the passport system; the expectation that the system is in place in principle by end 2027 is secondary-sourced, and no delegated act exists, which is why the instrument carries no passport date. WRONG AXIS, to be re-homed: the CPR uses 'product group' zero times and defines product family, then product category, then product type, with its own Annex VII family list. This binding keeps the existing catalog key so nothing breaks; re-homing it is a later step and needs CPR Annex VII read first.

notes: A real passport instrument, unlike the electronics pair — Art. 75 creates a construction DPP outright. Its first expected product families are rebar, cement, doors and windows with their hardware, and thermal insulation, of which our existing product-category list carries only cement. The passport is undated because the text dates it against an act that does not exist yet. Art. 22(7): 'By 18 months after the entry into force of the delegated act referred to in Article 75(1) the manufacturer shall make available a digital product passport referred to in Article 76'. Art. 75(1) leaves that delegated act, which sets up the construction DPP system, to the Commission, and none has been adopted. Once it is, the date is its entry into force plus 18 months, sourced from both articles. Two dates that are not the passport date. 8 January 2026 is Art. 96's general application date: Arts. 75 and 76 apply from that day, but Art. 22(7) is what says when a manufacturer owes a passport, and it points past Art. 96; this record carried 2026-01-08 as a sourced passport date until that was found. And 8 January 2027 is Art. 96's date for Art. 92, which is Penalties.
